title: On the Faithful Projective Representations of Finite Groups and their Minimal Dimension
summary: The first part of this article is devoted to characterizing the cocycles $α$ of a finite group $G$ that give rise to faithful projective representations of $G$. We prove that a $p$-group $G$ admits a faithful irreducible projective representation if and only if the cohomology class $[α]$ does not lie in the image of the inflation map $\operatorname{inf}: \mathrm{H}^2\!\left(G / N, \mathbb{C}^{\times}\right) \longrightarrow \mathrm{H}^2\!\left(G, \mathbb{C}^{\times}\right)$ for any non-trivial central subgroup $N$ of $G$.
